turns.content: Dimethyl malonate reacts with methyl (E)-3-(p-tolyl)acrylate under NaOEt in ethanol. Determine major product A and justify the Michael-addition regiochemistry.

Analyze the reaction of 1-(cyclohex-1-en-1-yl)piperidine with (E)-but-2-enenitrile followed by MeOH/H3O+. Determine isolated product B and explain both enamine conjugate addition and the acidic workup.
A donor C reacts with but-3-en-2-one under KOH/water to give 2-(3-oxobutyl)cyclohexane-1,3-dione. Infer the neutral starting donor C.
State the working assignments for A, isolated B, and C from the three analyses.
Check that A follows malonate conjugate addition, B includes hydrolysis during workup, and C is the neutral 1,3-dicarbonyl donor rather than a base-generated tautomer.
Report A, B, and C with one concise mechanistic justification for each.
